fields.server.global.scrape_interval: How often Prometheus collects metrics from targets that use the default schedule. Choose a shorter interval to capture changes sooner, at the cost of more samples.
fields.server.retention: Keep historical samples for this duration so queries can cover the required time window while bounding how long samples remain on disk.
fields.server.persistentVolume.enabled: Use persistent storage when samples must survive replacement of the Prometheus server Pod.
fields.server.persistentVolume.size: Reserve enough storage for the retained samples on the Prometheus data volume.
fields.server.resources: Set requests to give the scheduler capacity requirements and limits to bound the server’s resource use.
fields.alertmanager.enabled: Enable Alertmanager when Prometheus alerts need to be grouped and delivered to receivers.
fields.kube-state-metrics.enabled: Enable kube-state-metrics when you need metrics about the state of Kubernetes objects.
fields.server: Configure the Prometheus server that scrapes targets and stores time-series data.
fields.server.global: Set defaults for Prometheus scrape jobs and rule evaluation.
fields.server.persistentVolume: Configure storage for the Prometheus time-series database.
fields.alertmanager: Configure the Alertmanager dependency that routes notifications.
fields.kube-state-metrics: Configure the dependency that exposes the state of Kubernetes objects as metrics.
fields.server.resources.requests: Resources Kubernetes reserves when scheduling this container.
fields.server.resources.requests.cpu: CPU request for this container, expressed in cores or millicores.
fields.server.resources.requests.memory: Memory request for this container, expressed as a Kubernetes quantity.
fields.server.resources.limits: Upper bounds Kubernetes enforces for this container.
fields.server.resources.limits.cpu: CPU limit for this container, expressed in cores or millicores.
fields.server.resources.limits.memory: Memory limit for this container, expressed as a Kubernetes quantity.
fields.configmapReload: Configure the sidecar that reloads Prometheus when its configuration changes.
fields.configmapReload.prometheus: Configure the Prometheus server configuration reloader.
fields.configmapReload.prometheus.image: Choose the container image for the Prometheus configuration reloader.
fields.configmapReload.prometheus.image.tag: Use v0.95.2 for ARM64 support. The pinned chart defaults to amd64-only v0.95.1.
fields.alertmanager.configmapReload: Configure the sidecar that reloads Alertmanager when its configuration changes.
fields.alertmanager.configmapReload.image: Choose the container image for the Alertmanager configuration reloader.
fields.alertmanager.configmapReload.image.tag: Use v0.95.2 for ARM64 support. The pinned chart defaults to amd64-only v0.95.1.

dependencyHints.server.persistentVolume.size: Enable persistent storage to set the size.
